item.tib: phyogs kyi dgon sde rnams kyi bca' yig sdom pa gsum gyi bslab btus shel dkar me long
item.coloph: ces pa 'di ni bstan dang 'gro ba la lhag bsam mchog tu rgyas pa'i mkhan chen dam pa g.yung drung tshul khrims bstan 'dzin dbang po'i zhal snga nas 'di lta bu zhig dgos pa'i bka' rtsal spyi bor mchod nas skyabs rje dam pa shar rdza ba chen po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos reg pa'i gshen btsun khod spungs kyi rus su byung ba bzhin bon smra ba ngag dbang skal bzang bstan rgyal nas 'chad nyan gyi thun gseng 'ga' zhig la nye bar sbyar ba'o//
